title: SharedCard
description: What leaves the device when a card is shared with other people (target share, ADR-0036): content and provenance only. No store identity (uri, externalId), no origin system, no source other than a public address, no worlds, tags, class, visibility, release, training, status, rating, edges, structured state or private player field (personalityType), no language, validity period, aliases or external refs (ADR-0048), and no player entry without a public source. contentHash is the hash of this projection (ADR-0034). Built by shareProjection in packages/core after the gate allowed the card for share.

source.description: Kept only as a public http or https address; any other source is dropped (ADR-0036).

allOf.description: A shared evidenced or said card names its public external source (ADR-0036).

playerField.title: SharedPlayerField
playerField.description: Player-field entries that cite a public source only.

publicSourceRef.title: PublicSourceRef
publicSourceRef.description: An absolute http or https address without user information: a public external source (ADR-0036). The schema checks the form; isPublicSourceUri in packages/core also rejects IP literals, private and special-use host names.
